task_org_system_key_uidx.name: task_org_system_key_uidx
task_org_system_key_uidx.where: "task"."scope" = 'organization' and "task"."system_key" is not null and "task"."archived_at" is null

task_site_system_key_uidx.name: task_site_system_key_uidx
task_site_system_key_uidx.where: "task"."scope" = 'site' and "task"."system_key" is not null and "task"."archived_at" is null

task_org_scope_consistency.name: task_org_scope_consistency
task_org_scope_consistency.value:
("task"."scope" = 'site' and "task"."organization_id" is null) or
      ("task"."scope" != 'site' and "task"."organization_id" is not null)
